corpus_crossquery.query: Which canonical and discovery statements rely on Steinberg 2021, and do its methods, panels, raw tables and peer review support their strength?
corpus_crossquery.finding: The human-organoid phenotype and reversibility proof-of-concept remain useful. GABA depolarization is an unmeasured mechanistic interpretation; the bulk RNA-seq metabolic signature is maturity/composition-confounded; final RNA-seq n is 2 WT versus 4 KO; and WWOX rescue is ubiquitous supraphysiological expression with partial rescue. DL-MECH-098 records the correction.

entries.proposition: For the TBR1 and SATB2 sub-panels of Figure 4H no WT-versus-W-AAV bracket is drawn. Under the legend's stated all-pairwise one-way ANOVA with Tukey's multiple comparisons test, that absence indicates a comparison performed and NOT significant - not a comparison omitted. So the rescue normalises these two markers to wild type while the CTIP2 endpoint overshoots it.
